description: This 1996 Chevrolet C/K 1500 Series K1500 Silverado Regular Cab is a full-size pickup from Chevrolet's C/K lineup, built with the straightforward proportions and body style associated with that era. The regular cab body provides seating for two in a single-row cabin, and the truck uses the short, practical exterior profile typical of a two-door work-oriented pickup. Silverado trim places it in the higher grade of the series, with cabin and exterior details that are more finished than the base versions while keeping the truck's core utility intact.This 1996 Chevrolet C/K 1500 Series K1500 Silverado Regular Cab is identified as a 1500-series model, which places it in the light-duty half-ton range. That designation is part of the truck's basic specification and reflects how Chevrolet organized the C/K line during the 1990s. The K1500 name indicates four-wheel drive, and that hardware distinguishes it from the rear-drive C-series trucks in the same family. The Silverado badge also appears on the exterior and within the interior presentation, as Chevrolet used the name for one of the better-equipped trims available on these pickups.This 1996 Chevrolet C/K 1500 Series K1500 Silverado Regular Cab uses the familiar Chevrolet truck body from that period, with a squared-off hood, broad front fascia, and a tall cab that leaves room for the driver and passenger. The regular cab means there are no rear doors and no rear bench, and the pickup bed sits behind the cabin in the usual long-format arrangement for this body style. Side mirrors, door handles, and the overall sheetmetal follow the clean, angular design language common to mid-1990s GM trucks, with exterior pieces kept simple and functional. The model year also places it in the final phase of the GMT400 generation, before Chevrolet moved to the next truck platform.This 1996 Chevrolet C/K 1500 Series K1500 Silverado Regular Cab is the kind of truck that was commonly used for towing, hauling, and general transport, and the K1500 drivetrain gives it the traction advantage associated with a four-wheel-drive pickup. The Silverado trim typically included a more complete cabin presentation than lower grades, and this series was available with a range of equipment depending on how it was ordered. Chevrolet's truck buyers in 1996 could choose among different powertrain and option combinations, but the core identity of this example remains centered on its half-ton chassis, four-wheel-drive system, regular-cab body, and Silverado specification.

description: ====== 2018 Chevrolet Equinox LT AWD | Cajun Red | Sun & Infotainment | Confidence & Convenience | No Accidents ======*101,582 miles*If you're looking for a comfortable, well-equipped AWD SUV without spending new-car money, this *2018 Chevrolet Equinox LT AWD* deserves a close look. Finished in *Cajun Red Tintcoat over Jet Black*, it combines all-wheel-drive capability, strong fuel economy and some of the most desirable option packages available on the Equinox LT.And unlike the many Equinoxes that left the factory fairly basic, this one had an original suggested price of *$34,270*, including *$4,775 in added factory features*.===== NO ACCIDENTS OR DAMAGE REPORTED TO CARFAX =====That's the headline we like to see on a used vehicle.CARFAX reports *no accidents or damage*, no structural damage, no airbag deployment, no total-loss history, no odometer rollback indication and no open manufacturer recalls reported. It has been a *personal-use vehicle* and was last owned here in Minnesota.The CARFAX also shows *27 service history records*, including a long history of documented oil changes and maintenance. CARFAX specifically notes that its oil changes have been performed regularly.===== AWD + TURBOCHARGED EFFICIENCY =====Power comes from Chevrolet's *1.5L turbocharged 4-cylinder engine* paired with *all-wheel drive*, making this Equinox a practical choice for Minnesota's constantly changing interpretation of what constitutes reasonable weather.The original vehicle specifications list fuel economy at an estimated *24 MPG city and 30 MPG highway*, giving you SUV versatility and AWD traction without feeding it like a full-size truck.Additional mechanical features include StabiliTrak stability control with Traction Control, a 3.87 final-drive ratio, MacPherson-strut front suspension, four-link rear suspension and Chevrolet's engine stop/start system.===== $4,775 IN FACTORY OPTIONS =====This Equinox started with a *$28,500 base suggested price*, but the original equipment information shows another *$4,775 in factory-added equipment*, plus destination, bringing the total suggested price to *$34,270*.The big-ticket options include:*Sun & Infotainment Package -- $1,995**Confidence & Convenience Package -- $1,945**8-Way Power Driver Seat with Power Lumbar -- $400**Cajun Red Tintcoat -- $395*Those packages are a major reason this Equinox stands apart from more basic LT models. Rather than settling for the equipment normally associated with an LT, the original buyer spent nearly $5,000 adding comfort, convenience and technology.===== COMFORTABLE, PRACTICAL AND EASY TO LIVE WITH =====Inside you'll find a *Jet Black interior* with an 8-way power driver's seat including power lumbar support, push-button Keyless Start, electronic cruise control, rear-window defogger, illuminated vanity mirrors, overhead sunglass storage and plenty of passenger and cargo flexibility.The exterior is highlighted by the upgraded *Cajun Red Tintcoat*, HID headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, deep-tinted rear glass, bright lower-window trim and body-color door handles and mirror caps.Safety equipment includes a Rear Vision Camera, StabiliTrak with Traction Control, multiple airbags, Tire Pressure Monitoring with Tire Fill Alert and Chevrolet's Teen Driver system. Teen Driver allows configurable vehicle settings associated with a key fob and can provide an in-vehicle report on driving behavior, a pretty clever feature for families with a newer driver in the household.===== CARFAX GOOD RELIABILITY FORECAST =====CARFAX gives this Equinox a *Good Reliability* forecast based on comparable 2018 Chevrolet Equinox models from the same region with similar mileage.It ranks in the *top 50% compared with similar vehicles*, with CARFAX projecting an average repair cost of approximately *$320 per year* over the next three years. CARFAX also specifically recognizes its history of regular oil changes. Naturally, that's a forecast rather than a promise. Cars stubbornly refuse to read statistical projections before deciding what they're going to do.===== LONG-TERM MINNESOTA OWNERSHIP =====CARFAX reports five previous owners, all identified as personal-use ownership. More importantly, the most recent owner purchased the Equinox in *February 2022 at approximately 46,865 miles* and kept it for about *41/2 years*, with CARFAX estimating only *12,005 miles per year*, below the industry-average benchmark of 15,000 miles.During that ownership period, CARFAX documents regular service at Lupient Chevrolet of Bloomington, including maintenance inspections and repeated oil changes. Records appear at 52,154, 59,468, 66,566, 73,995 and 80,033 miles, followed by another documented oil and filter change at 87,448 miles.That is exactly the kind of service history worth paying attention to on a vehicle with more than 100,000 miles.===== RECENTLY SERVICED AT METROPOLITAN FORD =====We didn't simply take it in, photograph it and hope everyone remained optimistic.CARFAX shows that *Metropolitan Ford serviced the Equinox on August 5, 2026*, performing a *maintenance inspection and oil and filter change* while preparing it for sale. CARFAX even calls out that recent service as a positive highlight on the report.With *101,582 miles*, AWD, attractive Cajun Red Tintcoat, nearly $5,000 in original factory options, excellent equipment, documented maintenance and a CARFAX showing *no accidents or damage reported*, this Equinox offers a lot of SUV for the money.For someone looking for an affordable AWD commuter, first vehicle, college vehicle or versatile second SUV, this *2018 Chevrolet Equinox LT AWD* checks an impressive number of boxes without requiring a ridiculous budget.*Pricing and third-party valuation information, when referenced, were captured August 8, 2026. description: 2015 GMC SIERRA 2500HD DENALI CREW CAB 4X4 DURAMAX  ONE OWNER  $75,640 MSRP  INCREDIBLE SERVICE HISTORY  FACTORY OFF-ROAD PACKAGE  FUEL MAVERICKS  NITTO RIDGE GRAPPLERS  This is an absolutely outstanding example of a properly owned and properly maintained heavy-duty diesel trucka 2015 GMC Sierra 2500HD Denali Crew Cab 4x4 with 178,719 miles, finished in Onyx Black over Jet Black leather, with the legendary 6.6L Duramax turbo-diesel, an outstanding one-owner history, exceptional dealer service records, and a tremendous combination of factory equipment and tasteful upgrades.  The biggest story with this truck is the ownership.  This is a ONE-OWNER truck from new, and the service history is honestly about as impressive as you could ask for on a truck of this age and mileage. It has been dealer serviced and maintained throughout its life with extensive documentation going all the way back to the beginning of ownership.  When you are buying a Duramax with 178,719 miles, this is exactly what you want to find. These trucks are built to accumulate mileage, but maintenance is everything. A one-owner Duramax with consistent service records is a completely different vehicle than a truck that has changed hands four or five times with an unknown history.  This one has the pedigree.  And when it was new, this was a serious truck.  ORIGINAL MSRP  $75,640  The original base price of this Sierra 2500HD Denali was $56,550, and it was then equipped with nearly $18,000 in additional factory equipment, bringing the total original suggested retail price to an impressive:  $75,640  That was substantial money for a pickup in 2015, and it gives you an idea of just how highly equipped this truck was when ordered.   6.6L DURAMAX TURBO-DIESEL  $7,195 FACTORY OPTION  The centerpiece of this truck is the legendary 6.6-liter Duramax turbo-diesel V8, which alone added $7,195 to the original window sticker.  For 2015, the Duramax was rated at approximately 397 horsepower and 765 lb-ft of torque, giving the Sierra 2500HD tremendous pulling power and making it one of the most desirable heavy-duty diesel powertrains of its era.  The Duramax is paired with the heavy-duty Allison automatic transmission, a combination that has earned a tremendous reputation in the diesel truck world for its durability, towing characteristics, and long-term service capability.  There is a reason people specifically shop for a Duramax/Allison truck.  The Allison transmission is engineered to handle the enormous torque output of the Duramax, and together the two make this an incredibly capable package whether you are towing, hauling, traveling, or simply wanting one of the best diesel combinations GM has produced.  Add in the fact that this particular truck has been under the care of one owner with outstanding maintenance records, and it becomes even more appealing.   DENALI PACKAGE  The Denali was GMC's flagship luxury trim and represented the top of the Sierra lineup.  This wasn't simply a heavy-duty work truck with leather added to it. Denali gave the Sierra a completely different level of interior finish, exterior appearance, comfort, technology, and convenience equipment.  The exterior receives the unmistakable Denali appearance treatment, including the upscale Denali grille, extensive chrome detailing, premium body-color trim, and additional exterior appointments that immediately distinguish it from a standard Sierra.  Inside, the Denali transforms the truck into a legitimate luxury vehicle.  It features a Jet Black premium leather interior, upgraded trim throughout the cabin, and an enormous amount of comfort and convenience equipment.   PREMIUM LEATHER INTERIOR  The Denali cabin features premium leather seating surfaces with a much more upscale finish than lower Sierra trim levels.  The front seating offers extensive power adjustment to allow the driver and passenger to find a comfortable seating position whether you are making a short commute or spending hours towing down the highway.  The interior also incorporates premium materials and Denali-specific accents throughout the dashboard, center console, doors, seating, and trim surfaces.  For a heavy-duty truck, the interior remains remarkably luxurious even by today's standards.   HEATED & VENTILATED FRONT SEATS  The front seats are both heated and ventilated, one of the best luxury features available on these trucks.  During colder weather, the heated seats provide immediate comfort before the entire cabin has warmed up.  During Texas summers, the ventilated seat function is equally valuable, circulating air through the seat surfaces and making the leather considerably more comfortable.   HEATED STEERING WHEEL  The truck is also equipped with a heated steering wheel, another premium Denali feature that adds significantly to cold-weather comfort.   DRIVER MEMORY SYSTEM  The driver's seat includes memory settings, allowing preferred seating positions to be stored and recalled.  This is especially useful when multiple people drive the truck, as the driver can quickly return the seating position to his or her preferred configuration.   POWER-ADJUSTABLE PEDALS  The truck features power-adjustable pedals, allowing the accelerator and brake pedals to move closer to or farther away from the driver.  This allows the driver's seating position to be adjusted without sacrificing comfortable access to the pedals.   BOSE PREMIUM AUDIO  The Denali is equipped with the upgraded Bose premium audio system.  Bose systems were specifically tuned for the Sierra cabin and provide a noticeably richer and more powerful sound experience than the standard audio system.   FACTORY NAVIGATION / INFOTAINMENT SYSTEM  The truck is equipped with GMC's premium infotainment system with factory navigation, giving you integrated mapping and vehicle controls through the center display.  The infotainment system also integrates audio, Bluetooth connectivity, vehicle settings, and additional information into one central interface.   BLUETOOTH CONNECTIVITY  Bluetooth allows compatible phones to connect wirelessly for hands-free calling and compatible audio functions.  Steering-wheel-mounted controls allow many functions to be operated without taking your hands away from the wheel.   POWER SUNROOF  $995 FACTORY OPTION  This Sierra was additionally ordered with the optional power sunroof, which added $995 to the window sticker.  It gives the already large Crew Cab cabin an even more open feeling and was a desirable option that was certainly not found on every Sierra 2500HD Denali.   DRIVER ALERT PACKAGE  $450 FACTORY OPTION  This truck was also ordered with GMC's optional Driver Alert Package, a $450 factory option.  For a 2015 heavy-duty pickup, this was advanced driver-assistance technology.  The package includes:  FORWARD COLLISION ALERT  Forward Collision Alert is designed to monitor traffic ahead and warn the driver when the system detects that the Sierra may be approaching another vehicle too quickly.  On a nearly 8,000-pound heavy-duty diesel truckespecially one that may frequently be towinghaving an additional warning system like this is extremely valuable.  LANE DEPARTURE WARNING  Lane Departure Warning monitors the truck's position in the lane and can warn the driver when it senses the vehicle drifting out of its lane without the turn signal being activated.  This is particularly useful during extended highway trips.  SAFETY ALERT DRIVER SEAT  Instead of relying solely on an audible alert, GMC incorporated its Safety Alert Seat.  The driver's seat cushion can vibrate to indicate the direction of a potential hazard or lane departure.  It was a very innovative safety feature for its time and remains one of the more unique GM driver-alert systems.   REAR VISION CAMERA WITH DYNAMIC GUIDELINES  The truck is equipped with a factory rearview camera with dynamic guidelines.  The guidelines move with steering input, helping the driver line the truck up when reversing into a parking spot, hooking onto a trailer, or backing into a confined space.  On a Crew Cab heavy-duty truck, the rear camera is an extremely useful feature.   FRONT AND REAR PARK ASSIST  The truck is equipped with parking-assistance technology designed to warn the driver when approaching objects while maneuvering at low speed.  Given the overall length and size of a 2500HD Crew Cab, this is an excellent convenience feature for parking.   POWER-ADJUSTABLE CAMPER-STYLE TOW MIRRORS  $230 FACTORY OPTION  The original owner also added the optional power-adjustable camper-style towing mirrors, a $230 option.  These aren't ordinary mirrors.  They feature a heavy-duty vertical design specifically intended to provide increased visibility when towing.  The equipment includes:  Power adjustment  Heated mirror glass  Power-folding functionality  Manual extension for additional towing visibility  Driver memory integration  Integrated turn-signal indicators  Lower convex spotter mirrors  Auxiliary clearance lighting  The convex lower mirror significantly improves visibility beside the truck and trailer, while the extendable housing provides additional rearward visibility when towing a wide trailer.  For anyone actually using a 2500HD for its intended purpose, these are an extremely valuable factory feature.   FACTORY OFF-ROAD EQUIPMENT / RANCHO SHOCKS  The truck is equipped with GMC's factory off-road suspension equipment, including Rancho shocks.  And this is an important correction from the earlier description:  The Rancho shocks are FACTORY equipmentnot an aftermarket addition.  The off-road suspension setup was designed to provide additional control and durability when driving over rough surfaces, gravel roads, ranch roads, job sites, and other conditions where a standard street-oriented suspension can be compromised.  Rancho has a long history supplying heavy-duty and off-road suspension components, and GM utilized Rancho dampers as part of its factory off-road packages.  The truck retains this equipment underneath today.   STABILITRAK STABILITY CONTROL  The Sierra is equipped with GM's StabiliTrak electronic stability control system.  StabiliTrak monitors vehicle movement and can intervene when the system detects a loss of directional control.  The system incorporates:  Electronic stability control  Traction control  Proactive Roll Avoidance  Trailer sway control  Hill-start assist  Trailer sway control is particularly valuable on a heavy-duty pickup, as the system is designed to recognize trailer movement and help bring the truck and trailer back under control.  Hill-start assist helps prevent unwanted rollback when starting from a stop on an incline.   INTEGRATED TRAILER BRAKE CONTROLLER  The Sierra 2500HD is equipped with a factory integrated trailer brake controller.  Rather than having an aftermarket controller mounted under the dashboard, the trailer braking system is integrated directly into the truck.  This allows the driver to adjust trailer-brake gain and manually apply trailer braking when necessary.  For anyone towing a heavy trailer, boat, camper, equipment trailer, or race trailer, this is an essential feature.   4X4 SYSTEM  Of course, this truck is four-wheel drive.  The 4x4 system gives the Sierra considerably more capability when dealing with poor weather, muddy job sites, boat ramps, ranch roads, loose surfaces, or off-road conditions.  Combined with the Duramax diesel, heavy-duty chassis, factory off-road suspension, and aggressive Nitto tires, this is an extremely capable package.   DUAL-ZONE AUTOMATIC CLIMATE CONTROL  The interior features dual-zone automatic climate control, allowing the driver and front passenger to select different temperature settings.  The system automatically adjusts fan speed and temperature to maintain the selected cabin temperature.   REMOTE VEHICLE START  Factory remote start allows the truck to be started before entering.  This is especially useful in Texas because it gives the air-conditioning system time to begin cooling the large Crew Cab interior before you get inside.   UNIVERSAL HOME REMOTE  The Denali includes a Universal Home Remote, allowing compatible garage doors, gates, or other home automation devices to be programmed directly into the truck.   110-VOLT AC POWER OUTLET  Inside the cabin is a 110-volt AC household-style power outlet.  This makes it possible to power or charge compatible electronics and equipment without needing a separate inverter.   POWER WINDOWS WITH EXPRESS FUNCTIONS  The Sierra is equipped with power windows, including express-up and express-down functionality for the driver and express-down functionality for the remaining windows.   POWER SLIDING REAR WINDOW  The truck includes a power sliding rear window, allowing the center portion of the rear glass to be opened or closed electrically from inside the cabin.   AUTO-DIMMING REARVIEW MIRROR  The interior rearview mirror incorporates automatic dimming, helping reduce headlight glare from vehicles behind you at night.   AUTO-DIMMING / POWER EXTERIOR MIRROR FEATURES  The truck's premium mirror equipment also includes heated and power features designed to increase convenience and visibility during poor weather and nighttime driving.   TIRE PRESSURE MONITORING SYSTEM  The truck includes a factory Tire Pressure Monitoring System, allowing the driver to monitor tire-pressure status and receive a warning if the system detects a low tire.   FACTORY AIRBAG SYSTEM  The Sierra incorporates a comprehensive factory airbag system that includes frontal, side-impact, and head-curtain protection for multiple seating positions.   DAYTIME RUNNING LAMPS  Factory Daytime Running Lamps improve vehicle visibility during daylight operation, while automatic exterior lamp control allows the exterior lighting system to respond to changing lighting conditions.   PROJECTOR HEADLIGHTS WITH LED SIGNATURE LIGHTING  The Denali features projector-style headlights with GMC's LED signature lighting, giving the front end a much more premium appearance than lower-trim HD trucks.   FOG LIGHTS  Factory front fog lamps provide additional forward illumination in poor visibility conditions.   CHROME DENALI EXTERIOR TREATMENT  The Denali exterior receives extensive chrome detailing, including:  Chrome bodyside moldings  Chrome mirror caps  Chrome door handles  Premium Denali grille treatment  These details combine with the Onyx Black paint extremely well and give this truck the unmistakable Denali appearance.   EZ-LIFT & LOWER TAILGATE  The truck features GMC's EZ-Lift and Lower tailgate system.  This assists with the weight of the heavy tailgate, making it easier to raise and allowing it to lower in a much more controlled manner.   LOCKING TAILGATE  The tailgate incorporates a factory lock utilizing the same key system as the ignition and doors, providing additional security for cargo in the bedespecially when combined with the hard tonneau cover currently installed.   FACTORY SPRAY-IN BEDLINER  Another excellent factory feature is the spray-on pickup box bedliner.  The factory liner is designed to protect the bed floor, sidewalls, and tailgate surfaces from scratches, dents, and everyday cargo damage.  Unlike a drop-in plastic liner, a bonded spray-in liner follows the contours of the bed and doesn't allow the same type of movement or debris accumulation underneath.   CORNERSTEP REAR BUMPER  The rear bumper incorporates GM's extremely useful CornerStep design.  Built-in steps at both rear corners of the bumper make it considerably easier to climb into the bed.  It's one of those simple GM truck features that you quickly appreciate once you've used it.   LED CARGO-BOX LIGHTING  Factory LED cargo-box lighting helps illuminate the bed at night, extremely useful when unloading tools, equipment, luggage, or cargo after dark.   REAR WHEELHOUSE LINERS  The truck also came equipped with factory rear wheelhouse liners, which help protect the inner wheel wells and give the underside of the bed a more finished appearance.   20-INCH FUEL OFF-ROAD MAVERICK WHEELS  GLOSS BLACK & MILLED  Moving into the tasteful modifications, the truck is now sitting on a great-looking set of 20-inch Fuel Off-Road Maverick wheels.  These are finished in gloss black with milled accents, which is an outstanding combination against the Onyx Black exterior and factory Denali chrome.  The Fuel Maverick has an aggressive multi-spoke design with machined/milled detailing cut into the face of the wheel.  Rather than simply being an all-black wheel that disappears underneath the truck, the milled accents highlight the spoke design and tie in beautifully with the chrome accents already found throughout the Denali exterior.  It's a very clean wheel choice for this body style.   33x12.50R20 NITTO RIDGE GRAPPLER TIRES  The Fuel wheels are wrapped in 33x12.50R20 Nitto Ridge Grappler tires.  The Ridge Grappler is one of the most popular premium truck tires available because it bridges the gap between an all-terrain and a full mud-terrain tire.  You get the aggressive sidewall and blocky tread appearance people want from an off-road tire without the excessive noise and harsh road manners that often accompany a traditional mud tire.  The 12.50-inch width gives the truck a broader, more aggressive footprint, while the approximately 33-inch diameter fills the wheel openings perfectly.  They look exactly right on this truck.   LEVELING KIT  The truck has been fitted with a leveling kit, bringing the front of the truck up to eliminate much of the factory nose-down rake.  This gives the Sierra a much more aggressive, balanced stance while remaining considerably more practical than a large suspension lift.  The leveling kit works perfectly with the 33-inch Ridge Grapplers and allows the larger tire and wheel combination to fill out the truck without dramatically changing the truck's overall usability.   FACTORY RANCHO SHOCKS  Again, the Rancho shocks visible underneath are part of the truck's factory off-road suspension equipment.  They complement the leveling kit and provide the heavy-duty damping characteristics intended for GMC's off-road-equipped HD platform.   FOLDING HARD TONNEAU COVER  The truck is also equipped with a hard folding tonneau cover over the bed.  This is a fantastic addition on a Crew Cab truck.  The hard construction offers substantially better cargo security than a conventional soft vinyl tonneau cover while also helping protect belongings from rain, dirt, and weather.  When full bed access is needed, the folding design allows the cover sections to be folded out of the way.  Combined with the factory locking tailgate, it effectively gives you a large covered storage area in the rear of the truck.   CUSTOM HUSKY FLOOR LINERS  Inside are Husky custom-fit all-weather floor liners.  These are designed around the exact contours of the Sierra floor and provide considerably more coverage than a standard flat floor mat.  The raised edges help trap dirt, mud, water, sand, and debris before it reaches the original carpeting.  Again, on a one-owner truck with 178,719 miles, seeing quality protective equipment like Husky liners is another small detail that tells you how the previous owner treated the vehicle.   ONE OWNER / EXCEPTIONAL SERVICE HISTORY  This is where I come back to what really makes this truck special.  We sell a lot of diesel trucks.  It is not difficult to find an older Duramax with mileage.  It is considerably harder to find one that has been in the hands of ONE OWNER since new and has an extensive dealer-service and maintenance history documenting its care from the beginning.  The records on this truck are genuinely impressive.  The odometer shows 178,719 miles, but the service history tells the rest of the story.  Diesel buyers know mileage alone doesn't determine the quality of a truck. How it was maintained, how consistently it was serviced, and who owned it can make all the difference.  This is exactly the type of history we want to see.   THE COMPLETE PACKAGE  Just look at everything this truck brings together:  2015 GMC Sierra 2500HD Denali Crew Cab 4x4  178,719 miles  One owner since new  Exceptional dealer-service history  Onyx Black exterior  Jet Black premium leather interior  $75,640 original MSRP  $56,550 base MSRP  Nearly $18,000 in factory options  6.6L Duramax turbo-diesel V8  Allison automatic transmission  4-wheel drive  Denali luxury trim  Factory off-road suspension equipment  Factory Rancho shocks  Driver Alert Package  Forward Collision Alert  Lane Departure Warning  Safety Alert Driver Seat  Rear Vision Camera with dynamic guidelines  StabiliTrak stability control  Trailer sway control  Hill-start assist  Factory integrated trailer brake controller  Power sunroof  Power camper-style tow mirrors  Heated tow mirrors  Power-folding mirrors  Manual extending tow mirrors  Integrated turn signals  Convex spotter mirrors  Auxiliary clearance lamps  Heated and ventilated leather front seats  Heated steering wheel  Driver memory  Power-adjustable pedals  Bose premium audio  Factory navigation  Bluetooth connectivity  Remote start  Dual-zone automatic climate control  Universal Home Remote  110-volt AC outlet  Power sliding rear window  Auto-dimming rearview mirror  Projector headlights  LED signature lighting  Fog lights  LED cargo-box lighting  Chrome Denali exterior trim  EZ-Lift and Lower tailgate  Locking tailgate  Factory spray-in bedliner  CornerStep rear bumper  Rear wheelhouse liners  20-inch Fuel Off-Road Maverick wheels  Gloss black and milled finish  33x12.50R20 Nitto Ridge Grappler tires  Leveling kit  Hard folding tonneau cover  Custom-fit Husky all-weather floor liners  This is a high-dollar Denali Duramax that was extremely well equipped from the factory, tastefully upgraded, andmost importantlyproperly cared for by one owner throughout its life.  With an original MSRP of $75,640, the Duramax/Allison drivetrain, Denali luxury equipment, factory off-road package, Driver Alert Package, power sunroof, premium towing mirrors, Fuel wheels, Nitto Ridge Grapplers, leveling kit, hard tonneau cover, and custom Husky liners, there is an enormous amount of truck here.  And we have this one priced extremely aggressively.  If you're shopping strictly by mileage, there will always be another truck.  If you're shopping for the right truckwith the right ownership history, the right maintenance history, the right drivetrain, the right equipment, and the right upgradesthis is the one that deserves a serious look.
